desc: Deendayal Port, formerly known as Kandla Port, is a seaport in the Kutch district of Gujarat. It was constructed in the 1950s as the chief seaport for western India after the loss of Karachi Port to Pakistan during Partition. It is one of India's major ports and handles significant volumes of crude oil and grain traffic. The port operates as a tidal port with extensive dry cargo terminals and oil jetties, serving a vast hinterland including northern and central India.
fact: It was constructed in the 1950s as the chief seaport for western India after the loss of Karachi Port to Pakistan · It is one of India's major ports and handles significant volumes of crude oil and grain traffic · The port sits on the Gulf of Kutch and has extensive infrastructure for bulk commodities including salt, textiles, and chemicals

desc: Mumbai Port is a major seaport located in the natural deep-water harbor of Mumbai, Maharashtra. It is the largest port in India by size and one of the busiest by cargo tonnage. The port was developed extensively by the British in the 19th century and has played a pivotal role in India's maritime trade. It handles a diverse range of cargo including petroleum, chemicals, textiles, and machinery through its three main docks: Prince's Dock, Victoria Dock, and Indira Dock.
fact: It is the largest port in India by size and one of the busiest by cargo tonnage · The port was developed extensively by the British in the 19th century · It handles a diverse range of cargo including petroleum, chemicals, textiles, and machinery · The port's Indira Dock was the first in Asia to be equipped with modern cargo-handling facilities

desc: Jawaharlal Nehru Port, also known as Nhava Sheva, is the largest container port in India. Located on the mainland across the harbor from Mumbai, it was commissioned in 1989 to relieve congestion at Mumbai Port. It handles over half of India's container cargo volume and is a key node on major international shipping routes. The port features state-of-the-art container terminals operated by global logistics firms and serves as a critical gateway for India's international trade.
fact: It is the largest container port in India, handling over half of the country's container cargo volume · It was commissioned in 1989 to relieve congestion at Mumbai Port · It features state-of-the-art container terminals operated by global logistics firms · Nhava Sheva is the busiest port on the western coast of India

desc: Mormugao Port is a major seaport located in the city of Mormugao, Goa. It is one of India's oldest ports, constructed by the Portuguese in 1888. The port is a leading exporter of iron ore, with mineral handling as its primary function. Located on the estuary of the Zuari River, it possesses a deep natural harbor that can accommodate large vessels. It also handles significant volumes of coal, limestone, and container traffic.
fact: It is one of India's oldest ports, constructed by the Portuguese in 1888 · It is a leading exporter of iron ore, with mineral handling as its primary function · It possesses a deep natural harbor on the Zuari River estuary · The port can accommodate large vessels up to 200,000 DWT

desc: New Mangalore Port is a major seaport located at Panambur, Mangalore, Karnataka. It is the only major port in Karnataka and the deepest port on the west coast of India. Constructed in 1974, the port is an all-weather, deep-water port protected by breakwaters. It handles a variety of cargo including petroleum products, iron ore, fertilizers, and coffee. The port serves as a crucial gateway for the industrial and agricultural exports of Karnataka and neighboring states.
fact: It is the only major port in Karnataka and the deepest port on the west coast of India · Constructed in 1974, it is an all-weather, deep-water port protected by breakwaters · It handles a variety of cargo including petroleum products, iron ore, fertilizers, and coffee · It is one of the few Indian ports capable of handling Panamax-size vessels

desc: Cochin Port is a major seaport located on the Willingdon Island in Kochi, Kerala. Built on the natural lagoon of Vembanad Lake, it is one of the finest natural harbors on the west coast of India. The port was developed by the British in the 1920s and has grown into a major hub for container traffic, cruise shipping, and the Indian Navy's Southern Command. It is also home to the Kochi LNG Terminal and the International Container Transshipment Terminal (ICTT) at Vallarpadam.
fact: It is one of the finest natural harbors on the west coast of India, built on the Vembanad Lake lagoon · It is home to the Kochi LNG Terminal and the International Container Transshipment Terminal (ICTT) at Vallarpadam · The port was developed by the British in the 1920s on Willingdon Island · Kochi Port is the main hub for cruise shipping in India

desc: Chennai Port is a major seaport located on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. It is the second-largest container port in India and one of the oldest artificial harbors on the eastern coast. Established in 1881, the port underwent significant modernization and now features three main docks and multiple terminals. It handles a diverse range of cargo including automobiles, machinery, iron ore, and petroleum products. Chennai Port is a key hub for the automotive export industry of southern India.
fact: It is the second-largest container port in India and one of the oldest artificial harbors on the eastern coast · Established in 1881, it underwent significant modernization · It handles automobiles, machinery, iron ore, and petroleum products · Chennai Port is a key hub for the automotive export industry of southern India

desc: Kamarajar Port, formerly known as Ennore Port, is a major seaport located on the Coromandel Coast about 24 km north of Chennai. It was commissioned in 2001 as India's first corporatized port and is the first major port in India to be operated as a public company. The port primarily handles coal, iron ore, petroleum products, and chemicals. It serves thermal power plants in the region and has dedicated cargo-handling facilities for bulk commodities. The port's deep draft can accommodate Cape-size vessels.
fact: It was commissioned in 2001 as India's first corporatized port · It is the first major port in India to be operated as a public company · It primarily handles coal, iron ore, petroleum products, and chemicals contributing to nearby thermal power plants · It can accommodate Cape-size vessels due to its deep draft

desc: V.O. Chidambaranar Port, formerly Tuticorin Port, is a major seaport located in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. It is an artificial deep-sea port constructed in 1974 and one of the fastest-growing ports in India. The port serves as a gateway for trade with Sri Lanka and the Maldives and handles cargo including coal, fertilizers, petroleum products, and edible oils. It is strategically located near the Gulf of Mannar and is the second-largest port in Tamil Nadu. The port features a dedicated container terminal and extensive storage facilities.
fact: It is an artificial deep-sea port constructed in 1974 and one of the fastest-growing ports in India · The port serves as a gateway for trade with Sri Lanka and the Maldives · It is the second-largest port in Tamil Nadu after Chennai Port · It handles coal, fertilizers, petroleum products, and edible oils

desc: Visakhapatnam Port is a major seaport located on the east coast of India in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. It is one of the largest cargo-handling ports in India and the deepest port on the eastern coast. The port is situated between the Yarada Hills and the Dolphin's Nose hill, providing natural protection. Constructed in 1933, it handles a wide range of cargo including iron ore, petroleum products, fertilizers, and coal. The port has an inner harbor and an outer harbor for deep-draft vessels and serves as the primary port for the mineral-rich regions of Odisha and Chhattisgarh.
fact: It is one of the largest cargo-handling ports in India and the deepest port on the eastern coast · Constructed in 1933, it sits between the Yarada Hills and Dolphin's Nose hill for natural protection · The port has an inner harbor and outer harbor for deep-draft vessels · It serves as the primary port for the mineral-rich regions of Odisha and Chhattisgarh

desc: Paradip Port is a major seaport located at Paradip in the Jagatsinghpur district of Odisha. It is situated at the confluence of the Mahanadi River and the Bay of Bengal. Constructed in 1966 and fully operational by 1977, it is one of the deepest ports in India and a critical gateway for the mineral and industrial exports of eastern India. The port primarily handles iron ore, coal, crude oil, and fertilizers. It features a modern mechanized coal-handling plant and a crude oil terminal with extensive storage capacity.
fact: It is situated at the confluence of the Mahanadi River and the Bay of Bengal · It handles primarily iron ore, coal, crude oil, and fertilizers · Constructed in 1966 and fully operational by 1977 · It is one of the deepest ports in India and a critical gateway for eastern India's industrial exports

desc: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, formerly Kolkata Port, is a major seaport located in Kolkata, West Bengal. It is India's oldest operating port, established by the British East India Company in 1870. The port is situated approximately 232 km upstream from the Bay of Bengal along the Hooghly River. It operates two distinct dock systems: the Kolkata Dock System and the Haldia Dock Complex. Despite challenges of river navigation and silting, it remains a vital port serving the vast hinterland of eastern India, Nepal, Bhutan, and the northeastern states.
fact: It is India's oldest operating port, established by the British East India Company in 1870 · It is situated 232 km upstream from the Bay of Bengal along the Hooghly River · It operates two distinct dock systems: Kolkata Dock System and the Haldia Dock Complex · It serves the vast hinterland of eastern India, Nepal, Bhutan, and the northeastern states
